en: Hand-tinted view of a lively city square with an oval fountain and water jets in the foreground. Behind the basin stands a tall Marian column topped with a haloed statue of the Virgin. To the left rises a baroque church tower with an onion dome. Grand façades line the square, including a department store marked 'KAUFHAUS FIEDLER'. Pedestrians and early automobiles are visible.
